meta.title: Leonida Trophy Compass
meta.verified: Names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags were cross-checked trophy by trophy between Insider Gaming (18 Nov 2026) and GTABase (18 Nov 2026): 55 of 55 agree. Both lists agree with Exophase and PSNProfiles per Planet GTA 6, which took its list from Exophase and cross-checked it with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements.

trophies.guide: This one pops on its own the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as the finish line, not a task: the route in this guide is the work, and the platinum is the receipt. Budget around 200 hours in total (GTABase and KeenGamer agree on that figure; Push Square allows up to 300+), most of it on the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. Everything is single-player and offline, there is no difficulty trophy and one playthrough is enough, so the only real cost is time.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list, and the one the whole clean-up phase serves. The 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, once the story is finished — everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It demands in full: every robbery including all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations, the underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. The rest is a share, not the whole set: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Work down the checklist itself rather than guessing — it is the only authoritative list of what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida count, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to pile them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Watch the count under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and turn on the map's Stunt Spots to sweep an area in one flight. Keep going past 250 — the 100% checklist wants 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress, then Activities, shows what is still missing. Most of these happen naturally while you chase other trophies, so check that screen before going out of your way — you may only be one or two short.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: A gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Treat each range as a short skill drill rather than a grind — learn one range's targets and timing, gold it, and move on. Range time also raises your Focus level, which pays off directly for Gunslinger, so do the ranges before you attempt that one.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for this trophy. While you are at a location, run its other races too: the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finishing a location in one visit saves a second trip across the state later.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Winning the same race again does not count, so keep a mental note of which ones you have already won and pick fresh events each time. Short, easy races are the efficient pick — the trophy counts wins, not how prestigious the event is.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui and he will text you, marking a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests until his challenge opens, then beat him at it. Fishing also counts toward Master of None, so this is a good early excuse to learn the fishing loop.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick whichever game you are best at; finishing one is all it takes, and it also ticks an activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not, so do not waste time counting those toward the eight. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed by the guide sites, so check the progress counter in your own trophy list as you go. None of these strands are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18. Meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last spot needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE MISSABLE WARNING: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it — so do not skip it. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as insurance.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Complete any three Collectible Card sets — you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is, so chase the three sets you are already nearest to finishing instead of starting fresh ones. Cards turn up as you explore, so this one fills in steadily during the clean-up sweep.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, drawn from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags — so scan whatever is in front of you rather than hunting one category. The 100% checklist wants 100 WAiNK scans too, so every scan here does double duty.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. Progress, then Challenges, marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play normally, so do not grind this one early — check the list during clean-up, pick the 50 easiest unfinished ones, and remember the 100% checklist needs 70, so you will be going back for twenty more anyway.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), build a 4-star Wanted Level and escape — it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so this often unlocks on its own while you work on Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City — open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — sit close together, which makes the chain short. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic; variety comes to you. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will earn this one anyway on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first — eat, drink or wash up at home, and Adrenaline makes it last longer — and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count, so pick a gang operation as your stage.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm — then find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well. Slow and quiet beats fast and loud here; one alarm ruins the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. Five of the eight vaults are enough for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all eight, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 if you want the next target handed to you.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away. If you would rather do it the heavy way, robbing a bank vault counts too, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. Either route works — pick the truck for speed, the vault if you are already doing Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the map is fully revealed. Do it in one dedicated flight during clean-up rather than hoping to stumble across the last corners — the map shows you exactly which patches are still dark.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the nine gangs; Progress, then Gangs, keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this trophy is really the first ninth of that longer job — start it early, note which gangs you have hit, and finish the set during clean-up.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies you already need for 100% will get you most of the way there; just remember to launder the bills instead of sitting on them.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest, so do not force it — buy the gear you actually want for other trophies and watch the total climb. If you are close at the end of clean-up, a round of car mods closes the gap in minutes.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy the eight garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The four garages the story gives you do not count, so do not be confused when the total looks short — only the eight bought ones matter. Buy them as soon as you can afford them: you need the free garage space for On the Spot anyway.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes rather than anything you would miss.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed — just play the story. This is also the mission that introduces Cal, who matters later for Baited My Tackle, so pay attention to the fishing basics here.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It pops once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? — so if you finish Chapter 1 and it has not appeared yet, start the next mission and it will land. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude: it is the one thing in this chapter that does not come back.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is where the map opens up: both characters become playable together after Coffee Break, which unlocks the partner trophies and the last meditation spot.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is where Andy's quests, Randy's Wish List and Tyrone's lab jobs all begin — take them as they appear rather than leaving them for the end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It cannot be missed. Chapter 4 is also where the bank vaults open (That's Where The Money Is…) and where the big story heists land, so the clean-up work starts getting serious from here.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of the story. Free roam carries on afterwards, so you can clean up everything else on this list after the credits — and there is no mission replay, but no trophy depends on how you play a mission, so play the finale however you like. Once it pops, the 100% checklist opens and the real platinum grind begins.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed — just keep playing the chapter's missions in order.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed. Heists are where the crew mechanics you will reuse in the vault robberies get their workout, so treat it as practice for Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play in Chapter 4. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed — keep following the chapter's mission line.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners in Chapter 4. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed — keep following the chapter's mission line.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed. Remember the airport layout from this mission — you will be back at VCIA on your own terms for Catch Me If You Can.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed — keep following the final chapter's mission line toward the finale.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The last one awards the trophy. They are still there after the story, so there is no rush — but do them in order, since each one only opens after the last.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from seven shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then — do not panic if he goes quiet. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story, so work through them whenever you are passing through Kelly County.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more, so bring them in clean.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job (Shut Down the Labs) awards the trophy. The labs are the work — clear them as you find them and the finale opens on its own.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet, so do not stop after the first hunt — the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, and finishing them is the safe route to this trophy.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.area: Mariana County — Mile Zero Air Station
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks are at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way in — the base is guarded — so bring armor and a fast exit plan, then enjoy the easy part once you are behind the armor.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. The location is known but the exact steps are not confirmed yet — GTABase lists the method as unconfirmed, so treat any specific bar or seat as a guess until the guide sites verify it. Go to Ocean Beach, look for a bar with a view, and try ordering a cocktail there; if it does not pop, wait for a confirmed method rather than burning an evening on guesses.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, in the style of the series' classic showroom smash — but no guide site has verified the exact steps yet, and GTABase lists them as unconfirmed. Do not chase this one on a guess: the honest move is to wait until a source confirms which showroom, which car and which window, then do it once and be done.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. GTABase reports a method but marks it unverified: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. The report says to take its three valuables — the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs) — and the trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back. Treat this as a lead, not a fact, until a second source confirms it.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. GTABase reports a method but marks it unverified: max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason and Lucia, then Strength, in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map, then Activities) with your partner along — training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home. If the report is right, this is a slow stat grind, not a one-off trick — so start training early and let it build while you do everything else.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. GTABase reports a method but marks it unverified: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players would get it without trying, and turning on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, lets you watch the count. One warning travels with the report: do not push towards the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent. Play normally, keep the notifications on, and let the count build; do not deliberately tank your profile for it.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but no guide site has verified what that something is, and GTABase lists the exact steps as unconfirmed. Do not guess: this is the kind of trophy where a wrong guess wastes more time than waiting for the answer. Check back once the guide sites have a confirmed method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida — the description reads like a reaction to something weird — but no guide site has verified where it is or what triggers it, and GTABase lists the exact steps as unconfirmed. The honest advice is to keep exploring and let the weird finds come to you, rather than hunting a location nobody has confirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: METHOD UNCONFIRMED. The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by — but no guide site has verified the exact steps yet, and GTABase lists them as unconfirmed. The shape of the task is clear enough to try once you have a fast vehicle and a target-rich road, but until a source confirms the details, treat any specific method as a guess.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
